observations: Four photos show black salon chairs with chrome bases and armrests, arranged in a yard or workshop.
The chairs have black upholstery, some showing wear and scuff marks.
Photo 0 shows multiple chairs, including one with a headrest and one without, both with chrome bases and footrests.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of a chair with a chrome base and footrest, and a visible lever for height adjustment.
Photo 2 shows a single chair with a chrome base, footrest, and armrests, with a headrest and a small cushion on the back.
Photo 3 shows a single chair with a chrome base, footrest, and armrests, with a headrest and a small cushion on the back.
The chairs appear to be used, with some dirt and scuff marks on the upholstery and chrome.
The setting is outdoors, with other chairs and materials visible in the background.
No brand or model is visible on any chair in any photo.
The seller claims 'Executive Salon chairs every part fully functional'.

claims.evidence: The chairs shown in the photos have the typical design of salon chairs: high back, armrests, and chrome bases, consistent with executive salon chairs.
No photo shows the chair in operation. The lever for height adjustment is visible in photo 1, but no proof of functionality is provided.

risks.risk: The chairs may not be fully functional (e.g., height adjustment, recline, or tilt mechanisms may be broken).
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the chair being adjusted in height, reclined, and tilted, demonstrating smooth operation.

risks.risk: The upholstery may be damaged or worn beyond repair, affecting durability and comfort.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the upholstery showing the extent of wear, tears, or stains.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn, with reduced value

risks.risk: The chrome base may be corroded or loose, affecting stability.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the chrome base and legs, showing no rust, cracks, or loose joints.

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the chair being adjusted in height, reclined, and tilted.
Close-up photos of the upholstery showing wear and damage.
Close-up photos of the chrome base and legs to check for corrosion or looseness.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
